title: Participant Support Costs Knowledge Review — Supporting Participants: Payments, Benefits, and Indirect Costs
display_label: Participant Support Costs Knowledge Review — Supporting Participants: Payments, Benefits, and Indirect Costs
content:
Participant Support Costs Knowledge Review

From the ORA eTraining module "Supporting Participants: Payments, Benefits, and Indirect Costs" (lesson 8 of 9).
incorrect
Knowledge check: What pool level in Banner, and associated account code, are used for stipends for students outside of Morgan State University?
  - 02, 02010  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - 02, 02030  [incorrect]
  - 12, 12042  [incorrect]
  - 12, 12043  [incorrect]
  Note on "02, 02010": Great job!
  Note on "02, 02030": Right budget, wrong account!
  Note on "12, 12042": Remember stipends for students outside of Morgan State have stipends billed under the 02 (Contractual Salaries) pool.
  Note on "12, 12043": Remember stipends for students outside of Morgan State have stipends billed under the 02 (Contractual Salaries) pool.
Knowledge check: What is the key distinction when determining participant vs. employee?
  - Payment amount  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Whether work is performed  [incorrect]
  - Project duration  [incorrect]
  - Department approval  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  Note on "Payment amount": Not a defining factor.
  Note on "Whether work is performed": Great job!
  Note on "Project duration": Not a defining factor.
  Note on "Department approval": Not a defining factor.
Knowledge check: Which Morgan State office should an admin contact for up-to-date cost information for tuition, fees, and health insurance?
  - Office of Research Administration  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Office of Financial Aid  [incorrect]
  - Office of the Comptroller  [incorrect]
  - Office of the Bursar  [incorrect]
  Note on "Office of Research Administration": While an important resource, this office does not provide this information.
  Note on "Office of Financial Aid": While an important resource, this office does not provide this information.
  Note on "Office of the Comptroller": While an important resource, this office does not provide this information.
  Note on "Office of the Bursar": Great job! Always check for the most up-to-date cost information when submitting tuition or health insurance coverage requests.
Knowledge check: Which of the following is a hallmark of a stipend?
  - Based on hours worked  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Paid for services  [incorrect]
  - Predetermined amount not tied to labor  [incorrect]
  - Includes fringe benefits  [incorrect]
  Note on "Based on hours worked": This is a better indicator for an employment contract.
  Note on "Paid for services": This is a better indicator for an employment contract.
  Note on "Predetermined amount not tied to labor": Great job!
  Note on "Includes fringe benefits": This is a better indicator for an employment contract.
Knowledge check: A student attends workshops and presents on research, but does not perform routing project work such as organizing files or managing data. What is appropriate?
  - Stipend  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Contract  [incorrect]
  Note on "Stipend": Great job!
  Note on "Contract": The distinction between stipends and contracts is critical. Please review that lesson in this module again.
Knowledge check: Participant support costs are excluded from:
  - MTDC base  [incorrect]
  - Direct costs  [incorrect]
  - Payroll  [incorrect]
  - Total project budget  [incorrect]
  Note on "MTDC base": Great job!
  Note on "Direct costs": Participant support costs are considered direct costs on sponsored projects.
  Note on "Payroll": Morgan's Payroll department is not involved in participant support processing.
  Note on "Total project budget": Participant support costs are included in a project's total budget.
Knowledge check: On sponsored projects, budget transfers out of participant support generally require:
  - PI approval only  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - ORA Budget Specialist approval  [incorrect]
  - Sponsor approval  [incorrect]
  - DRED VP approval  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: How often should stipend requests be submitted?
  - Quarterly  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Weekly  [incorrect]
  - Monthly  [incorrect]
  - As needed (no limit)  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: Which office processes fully approved stipend requests via check requests from the State of Maryland?
  - Office of Human Resources  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Office of Research Administration  [incorrect]
  - Office of Accounts Payable  [incorrect]
  - Office of Financial Aid  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: A grant has an indirect cost rate of 54% MTDC for on-campus research. A department transfers $18,000 into their Contractual Salaries line from their Participant Support line of their project budget. How does this transfer affect the project's indirect cost needs?
  - Indirect cost needs increase by $9,720  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Indirect cost needs decrease by $9,720  [incorrect]
  - Indirect cost needs do not change  [incorrect]
  - Direct costs increase by $9,720  [incorrect]
  Note on "Direct costs increase by $9,720": Direct costs will stay the same whether the budget is under contractual salaries or participant support.
Knowledge check: How does the process for covering health insurance for participants on sponsored projects differ between undergraduate and graduate students?
  - The processes are the same for both student classifications.  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Graduate students must be reimbursed after paying out of pocket.  [incorrect]
  - Undergraduate students must be reimbursed after paying out of pocket.  [incorrect]
  - Health insurance is more expensive for graduate students.  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: How much lead time is minimally required between a stipend request's DocuSign submission date and it's "Check Issue" date?
  - 30 calendar days  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - 45 calendar days  [incorrect]
  - 60 calendar days  [incorrect]
  - 20 working days  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: Which administrative team at Morgan generates the necessary budget funding codes (FOAPAL), upon receipt of the Notice of Award, for participant support cost requests?
  - Office of the Comptroller  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Human Resources  [incorrect]
  - Restricted Funds Accounting  [incorrect]
  - Office of Research Administration  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: What is the name of the code necessary to tie project participant tuition charges to sponsored project budgets in Banner?
  - tuition code  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - detail code  [incorrect]
  - participant support code  [incorrect]
  - research support code  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
